Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that “The First Seven Years” (1930) was more recent than “Cinesound Varieties” by relying on an initial 1929 listing for “Cinesound Varieties” without resolving conflicting sources. Subsequent, more authoritative references indicated a 1934 release, which makes “Cinesound Varieties” the more recent film. The error stemmed from drawing a conclusion before corroborating and reconciling the discrepant release years.
